correctness.rationale: For each antichain, signed filter differences give the exact antichain support lower bound. Rational clone expansion plus Dilworth partition gives the weighted-antichain polytope as the convex hull of chain indicators, extended by rational approximation. Its quadratic norm bound is sharp at alternating maximizing-chain normals. Equality in each step enforces zero-one normalized magnitudes, chain support, maximum inverse-square chain weight and alternating signs. Exact finite tests on 1221 poset-weight profiles corroborate the algebra, but do not prove the general theorem.

value.rationale: This determines a canonical Euclidean thickness invariant for all order polytopes and their arbitrary positive diagonal dilations, recovers the maximum weighted chain and classifies every minimizing normal, not merely a sample extremizer. Varying scales creates combinatorially interpretable metric transitions where chain-weight sums cross. Its antichain-difference-body mechanism explains the geometric invariant and has plausible use in geometric poset comparisons.
